sentences.text:
Varun Kumar Chouhan vs The State Of Bihar on 4 September,
2025

Author: Purnendu Singh
Bench: Purnendu Singh
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.14625 of 2025
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-94 Year-2024 Thana- Kamtaul District- D

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
=
 Varun Kumar Chouhan
 ... ...
 Versus
 The state of Bihar & Anr.
 ... ...

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ajit Kumar, App
 For the Uoi : Dr. Amitesh Kumar, Advocate
 Mr. Kumar Ganesh Gunjan, Advocate

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PURNENDU SINGH  ORAL ORDER 7 04-09-2025 No one appears on behalf of the petitioner.
Mr. Ajit Kumar, learned APP for the State and Dr. Amitesh Kumar along with Mr. Kumar Ganesh Gunjan, learned counsels for the Union of India are present.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Kamtaul P.S. Case No. 94 of 2024 registered under Sections 409 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Dr. Amitesh Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Union of India informs that the petitioner has misappropriated a sum of Rs.28,26,964/- for which FIR was lodged on 13.04.2024 after making a public announcement, as would appear from Annexure - D to the counter affidavit.

He further gives information that certain documents relating to the Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.14625 of 2025(7) dt.04-09-2025 treatment of the petitioner and his discharge, after getting treatment from AIIMS Patna, have also been brought on record.
The bail application was filed on 25.02.2025 and it was first taken on 28.03.2025.
A verbal request was made on the said date that the petitioner has not yet recovered and this Court granted interim protection to the petitioner.

The matter was again notified on 12.05.2025 and adjournment was sought on behalf of the Union of Varun Kumar Chouhan vs The State Of Bihar on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170030723/
1 India and time was granted for filing counter- affidavit.

entities.text: Union of Varun Kumar Chouhan vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been recorded vide order dated 19.06.2025 that counter-affidavit was handed over to the petitioner's counsel, who sought further time to reply the same but no reply has been filed by him till date.
The petition was adjourned vide order dated 22.07.2025 and it was again taken up on 12.08.2025.
4. Considering the manner in which crime has been committed appears to be very serious in nature.

To ascertain, as to whether, the petitioner is innocent and he had deposited the amount, in lieu of which computer generated details of debit and credit, in respect of all the account holders, showing that the deposits were made in their respective account, then certainly a case of misappropriation is made out when the entire amount so collected having fraudulently shown in the account of the account holder to have been credited but in absence of the same Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.14625 of 2025(7) dt.04-09-2025 actually being deposited by all the accused persons, call for criminal prosecution against the accused.
5.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Union of India seeks short adjournment to bring on record the passbook of all the concerned account holders and he will also request the Post Master General, Patna Bihar Circle, to entrust a responsible officer to produce the same before this Court.
6. As prayed for, re-notify on 11.09.2025 at 2.15 pm, among top 10 cases.
(Purnendu Singh, J) Ashishsingh/-
